# Advertisement
:::


### Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in Data-Driven Modeling and Structural Twins

Applications are invited for one (1) Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under the ANRF-ECRG sponsored project at the Department of Mechanical Engineering, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. 

**Project Title:** π-DUST: Physics-Informed Data-driven Modeling and Uncertainty Quantification with application to Structural Twins

**Principal Investigator:** Prof. Suparno Bhattacharyya

**Funding Agency:** ANRF-ECRG (Project No: PFMS/SRDP/1348/G)

**Project Tenure:** 3 years

**Fellowship:** INR 37,000 (Basic) + 20% HRA

#### **Job Description**
The selected candidate will contribute to π-DUST, a research program developing data-driven technologies for engineering systems. The project combines computational mechanics, artificial intelligence, uncertainty quantification, and digital-twin technology. The candidate will work within an interdisciplinary team and engage with collaborators from institutions such as Texas A&M University and Penn State University. This role offers opportunities to contribute to research publications, open-source software, experimental validation, and industry-relevant solutions while building an international research network.

#### **Essential Qualifications**
**I.** A First-Class B.Tech/B.E. (GATE qualified) or a First-class M.E./M.Tech./M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Applied Mechanics, Civil Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computational Engineering, or a related discipline.

**II.** Knowledge of solid mechanics, structural dynamics, or finite element methods.

#### **Desirable Qualifications**
**I.** Prior research experience in the application of AI/ML in structural systems is highly desirable.

**II.** Proficiency in Python and advanced computational/numerical tools (ANSYS Fluent, COMSOL Multiphysics, MATLAB, image-processing software).

**III.** Background in control systems.

**IV.** Candidates holding a Master's degree in relevant research areas or possessing peer-reviewed journal publications will be given preference.

#### **Age Limit**

The upper age limit is 32 years as of 1st January 2026 for UR candidates. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and women candidates will be applicable as per GoI norms.

---

### How to Apply
Interested and eligible candidates must apply by **August 27, 2026, at 11:55 PM**.

Apply using the job link: [Click here](https://forms.gle/Yap2J8Uyzb8tJ4Fk8)


OR


**1. Prepare your documents**
Create a single folder containing the following documents in PDF format: Biodata/CV, self-attested mark sheets/certificates from graduation onward, proof of age, caste certificate (if applicable), and work-experience certificates (if applicable). Upload this folder to Google Drive and ensure the link is set to "view-accessible".

**2. Email your application**

* **To:** suparno@iitism.ac.in

* **Subject:** Application for JRF (PI-DUST) - [Applicant's Full Name]

* **Body:** The email body should serve as your cover letter (maximum 400 words). Explain in your own words why you wish to join the project and how your education, projects, technical skills, or research experience support your interest. 

> **⚠️ IMPORTANT:** Do NOT attach any files directly to the email, as emails containing large attachments may be rejected by the IIT email system. AI-generated, generic, or templated emails are strictly discouraged. Long emails, incomplete applications, inaccessible Google Drive folders, or emails without the specified subject line may be discarded.
